text: I feel a sense of anticipation mixed with curiosity. The sterile yet modern environment suggests a space dedicated to learning or innovation. The lounge outside and the colorful, well-designed wall inside with displays and information about research and development invite me to ponder the energy of creative work. These surroundings evoke a sense of purpose, where the boundaries between thought and action, art and science, blur. I feel eager to engage, to reflect, and to participate in the pursuit of new knowledge.
